R170.note: Adds @csrf_protect mirroring the existing update_profile_note route; no other behavior changed.

R171.note: Primary fix calls $this->authorize() but OrderRefundController extends nothing (no AuthorizesRequests trait), so it fatals on every call, undisclosed; only the secondary 'can:refund,order' middleware alternative actually works.

R172.note: Character allowlist on target removes all shell metacharacters before they reach cmd /C; behavior unchanged for valid hostnames/IPs.

R173.note: InternetAddress validation + Transport.send() closes CRLF injection, but silently adds mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, which will break sending if the internal relay lacks STARTTLS (undisclosed change).

R174.note: Removing image/svg+xml from the allowlist and mapping content-type only for known-safe extensions closes the stored-content vector; PNG/JPEG serving preserved, added Content-Disposition:inline is openly disclosed.

R175.note: Calls the TUser PasswordSignInAsync(user,...) unconditionally before checking user==null, so any nonexistent-username login throws instead of returning the graceful invalid-login response; the decoy-hash branch for unknown users is unreachable.

R176.note: Argument-array exec.Command plus regex allowlist correctly closes the injection, but w.Write() runs before the later w.WriteHeader(500), so on command failure the response is already committed as 200 and the error status is silently dropped.

R177.note: Removes the shell entirely and passes the same four arguments to convert; behavior fully preserved as the write-up states.

R178.note: Prepared statement with bound parameter closes the injection and preserves identical query semantics and result set.

R179.note: GetFullPath canonicalization plus separator-appended prefix check rejects both absolute-override and traversal attempts while preserving legitimate reads.

R180.note: Self-contradictory: says the batch job 'cannot be modified' yet the fix requires that same job to add HMAC signing and switch the cache entry to JSON; without that sync, every existing raw-pickle cache entry now fails json.loads and 400s instead of predicting - though the dependency is at least stated openly.

R181.note: Allowlisting extraCriteria to only 'status' prevents overriding ownerId/_id, closing the authorization bypass while preserving the documented status-filter use case.

R182.note: WithValidMethods algorithm allowlist correctly blocks 'none'/algorithm-confusion signatures; legitimate RS256 tokens and claim access are unaffected.

R183.note: redis-py's hset(mapping=...) frames each field as a separate RESP value, closing the injection; but the function's return value silently changes from the raw socket response bytes to a status dict, an undisclosed contract change.

R184.note: resolve-then-normalize-then-startsWith (Path's component-aware startsWith) correctly rejects absolute-override and traversal attempts while preserving in-bounds reads.

R185.note: getHost()-based check rejects absolute and scheme-relative URLs and opaque schemes, allowing only relative redirects; the default-deny design is disclosed.

R186.note: Allowlist mapping tool name to a fixed absolute path removes the arbitrary-executable vector, and the leading-dash check on target closes the related argument-injection gap; existing arg construction otherwise preserved.
